summary:
Rootprint is an AI-powered agricultural decision-support platform designed to help farmers make smarter, more sustainable crop rotation decisions using NASA Earth observation data, soil information, and individual farming priorities.

Our project addresses the challenge of balancing agricultural productivity with environmental sustainability. By analyzing satellite-derived environmental indicators, soil conditions, crop characteristics, and farmers’ preferences, Rootprint provides personalized crop rotation recommendations that aim to improve soil health, optimize resource use, and support long-term agricultural productivity.

Beyond recommendations, Rootprint features an interactive dashboard, educational resources, and downloadable reports to make complex agricultural data accessible and actionable for farmers, regardless of their technical background.

Rootprint is important because unsustainable farming practices contribute to soil degradation, inefficient water use, and declining agricultural resilience. By transforming NASA’s scientific data into practical farming insights, we aim to empower farmers to make informed decisions that benefit both their livelihoods and the planet.

Our mission is simple: Better soil, smarter farming, a sustainable future.
details:
Project Details – Rootprint

Rootprint is an AI-powered agricultural decision-support platform that transforms NASA Earth observation data into practical, personalized crop rotation recommendations. Our goal is to bridge the gap between complex scientific information and everyday agricultural decision-making, helping farmers improve productivity while protecting the environment.

How Does Rootprint Work?

Rootprint combines satellite-derived environmental information, soil characteristics, crop requirements, and farmers’ individual priorities to evaluate potential crop rotation strategies.

Users can enter information about their agricultural land, soil conditions, and farming objectives. The platform uses this information alongside relevant Earth observation indicators to generate recommendations tailored to their needs.

Rather than suggesting crops based on a single factor, Rootprint considers multiple dimensions of agricultural sustainability, including soil health, water availability, environmental conditions, and long-term productivity.

The platform also includes an interactive dashboard, an educational module, and downloadable PDF reports that help users understand the reasoning behind recommendations and apply the insights to real-world agricultural decisions.

Benefits and Intended Impact

Rootprint addresses several interconnected challenges facing modern agriculture:

  • Soil Degradation: Encouraging crop rotation strategies that support soil fertility and long-term soil health.
  • Water Management: Helping farmers consider water availability and crop requirements when planning agricultural activities.
  • Agricultural Sustainability: Supporting decisions that balance productivity with environmental responsibility.
  • Accessibility: Making complex satellite and environmental data understandable to users without specialized scientific knowledge.
  • Education: Providing learning resources that help farmers understand sustainable agricultural practices.
  • Climate Resilience: Helping agricultural communities adapt their planning strategies to changing environmental conditions.

Our intended impact extends beyond individual farms. By making data-driven agricultural planning more accessible, Rootprint aims to contribute to climate-resilient agriculture, responsible resource management, and global food security.

The project aligns particularly with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, including SDG 2 (Zero Hunger), SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production), SDG 13 (Climate Action), and SDG 15 (Life on Land).

Technology and Development

Rootprint was developed using TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and Python, combining modern web development technologies with data processing and artificial intelligence.

Our technology stack includes:

  • TypeScript: Used to develop the platform’s interactive functionality, application logic, and user-facing features.
  • HTML: Provides the structural foundation of the web application.
  • CSS: Creates a responsive, visually engaging, and accessible user interface.
  • Python: Supports data processing, agricultural analysis, and AI-powered decision-making.
  • NASA Earth Observation Data: Provides satellite-derived environmental information to support agricultural recommendations.
  • Artificial Intelligence: Supports the interpretation of agricultural and environmental information to generate personalized crop rotation suggestions.
  • Data Visualization: Transforms complex agricultural and environmental information into understandable visual insights.
  • PDF Report Generation: Allows users to export personalized agricultural recommendations and analytical reports.

The platform is designed to operate through standard web browsers, eliminating the need for specialized hardware and making its capabilities accessible to a broader audience.

By integrating these technologies, Rootprint transforms scientific information into an interactive platform that helps farmers make informed and sustainable agricultural decisions.

Creativity and Innovation

What makes Rootprint distinctive is its focus on translating scientific information into practical decisions rather than simply displaying environmental data.

Many agricultural tools provide raw measurements, weather forecasts, or general crop suggestions. Rootprint takes a more integrated approach by combining Earth observation indicators with farmers’ individual needs to support crop rotation planning.

One of our key innovations is the emphasis on personalization. Agricultural recommendations should not be identical for every farmer because soil conditions, environmental factors, and farming priorities differ significantly between locations.

Rootprint aims to address this challenge by considering multiple variables when evaluating potential crop rotation strategies.

Another important aspect is explainability and education. We believe that farmers should not only receive recommendations but also understand the environmental reasoning behind them.

By combining personalized decision support, interactive visualization, educational resources, and downloadable reports within a single platform, Rootprint seeks to make sustainable agriculture more approachable and actionable.

Factors Considered During Development

Throughout development, our team focused on five essential principles: scientific relevance, environmental sustainability, accessibility, personalization, and scalability.

Scientific Relevance: We prioritized the use of NASA Earth observation information and relevant agricultural indicators to support meaningful recommendations.

Environmental Sustainability: We considered how crop rotation decisions can influence soil fertility, water consumption, and long-term agricultural productivity.

Accessibility: We designed the platform to make complex scientific information understandable to farmers without requiring advanced technical knowledge.

Personalization: We recognized that agricultural conditions vary across regions and that farmers may prioritize different outcomes, such as productivity, soil conservation, or resource efficiency.

Scalability: We designed Rootprint as a web-based solution with the potential to support agricultural communities across different geographical regions.

We also recognized that satellite-derived information cannot fully replace direct soil testing or local agricultural expertise. Therefore, Rootprint is designed as a decision-support tool rather than a substitute for professional agronomic judgment.

Our Vision

We envision a future in which every farmer, regardless of technical expertise or farm size, can benefit from scientific data and intelligent agricultural planning.

Our long-term ambition is to make Rootprint a globally accessible agricultural intelligence platform that empowers communities, promotes responsible land management, and supports a more sustainable food system.

Rootprint turns Earth observation into Earth preservation — one farming decision at a time.
